json.notes: The Conservatory of Flowers is a white painted timber-and-glass glasshouse. A tall central pavilion carries a glazed dome with a lantern and finial, and two long, low wings with barrel-curved glazed roofs run out to the west and east. I model the central pavilion as a walled block with a glass dome and lantern, and the two wings as glass barrel vaults springing from low white walls.
